Good Morning, Agent Owners!

The new internet may be agents carrying reusable skills, designing real
machines in minutes, and deciding which brands deserve an answer.
------------------------------
  Agent Plugins Go Cross-Platform
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/40eec9b4?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Vercel and partners including AWS, GitHub, Microsoft, OpenAI, and
Cursor launched Agent Plugins 1.0.0, an open standard for packaging Agent
Skills and MCP servers into one portable format. Using a simple plugin.json
manifest and fixed folders, authors can build once for compatible clients,
including ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, and VS Code,
without repackaging components separately. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/edb34280?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Motor Design Drops to 20 Minutes
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/97e5e210?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* Atlas Motion emerged from stealth with $11.5M in funding and says
its AI can compress motor design from roughly two months to about 20
minutes, then move new designs into scaled production within six weeks.
Founded by Tesla and defense-tech veterans, the startup is already shipping
10,000 motors monthly and targets 40,000 by December, mainly serving
defense customers. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/56f4aa5e?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Cloudflare Tracks AI Brand Visibility
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/05d7d7a8?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Cloudflare is launching its AEO Visibility Dashboard to show
brands whether AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Gemini cite, mention, or
recommend them. Unlike its Agent Readiness tool, which checks crawler
access, the new dashboard measures what happens after content is read. *Read
more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/6d4257af?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  AI Is Taking Coworkers’ Tasks
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/2df231bb?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* Nearly half of employed U.S. adults now use AI at work, according
to an Epoch AI-Ipsos poll of roughly 1,100 workers. One in five said they
use AI for tasks previously given to colleagues or contractors, while
document reading and data analysis were common uses. Researchers say AI is
reshaping individual tasks faster than replacing entire jobs. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/fe46233c?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Reddit Moves Against AI Scraping
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/1a278b5e?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR: *Reddit is tightening Old Reddit as it tries to stop AI companies
and automated systems from scraping its valuable user-generated data. The
legacy site will require logins, while bots and moderator workflows move to
newer infrastructure. Reddit hasn’t revealed all planned restrictions yet,
but the changes show how aggressively platforms are starting to protect
content from AI crawlers. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/50f684c9?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
------------------------------
  Grokipedia Stops Updating
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/d05bfbc2?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>

*TL;DR:* Elon Musk’s Grokipedia appears to have largely stopped processing
edits since late April, according to a Lawfare analysis of 34,519 pages and
225,496 suggested changes. No corrections were accepted or rejected over
the past three months, while user activity dwindled and its live edit feed
broke earlier. Musk has not publicly mentioned the Wikipedia rival since
February. *Read more →*
<https://newsletter.myclaw.ai/r/ab753537?m=2eaf3154-2af3-4e54-b574-fba62b0fa39d>
